name: yacrum
description: Sales routines on your Yacrum CRM: morning signals, re-engaging a deal, an account pulse before a meeting, the weekly pipeline review, and qualifying an opportunity against its scoring template and stage gates. Outreach is drafted in your own mailbox with the workspace's logging address; nothing is ever sent.

apiKey.title: Yacrum API key
apiKey.description: A key an Admin made for you at Administration → API Keys (yk_…). Choose Read and write to let Claude log activity, create action items and move opportunities.

url.title: Yacrum address
url.description: Your Yacrum address. Leave as it is unless you were given another.
